notes.title: v9.01 - Now Available for Download! + Update for Early Access Ending Date
notes.content:
The v9.01 update for My First Date RPG is now available to download! Here are the update notes for v9.01:

v9.01
-Steam achievements can now be earned through gameplay
-Various graphic updates

As of update v9.01, all features of the full version of the game are now available!

However, we have updated the date for our game leaving Steam Early Access from "Sunday, August 25th, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time" to "Sunday, September 1st, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time." This update will release as one of the video game releases for week #180 of Bible Video Game Sundays! We're sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you again for playing during the Early Access period!

Stay tuned here and on our website for new version release updates!

Thank you for buying, playing, reading, and watching! Have fun!

(*release dates and times subject to change)

notes.title: v8.00 - Now Available for Download! + Update for Early Access Ending Date
notes.content:

-Updated graphics

Also, we have updated the date for our game leaving Steam Early Access from "Sunday, June 2nd, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time" to "Sunday, July 14th, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time" When the game leaves Early Access, Story Five for Oriana and Elliot will be playable! The v9.00 update will be available on Sunday, July 14th, 2024 at 6:00 AM Eastern Time* as one of the video game releases for week #173 of Bible Video Game Sundays!

Stay tuned here and on our website for new version release updates!

Thank you for playing, reading, and watching, and have fun!
